title: PubliX Group partners with digiPlant
lead: A market leader within application management systems for foundations, strengthening PubliX's position in the grant management vertical.
body_html:
STOCKHOLM, 25 August 2025 — PubliX Group has entered a partnership with digiPlant, a market leader within application management systems for foundations. digiPlant, founded in Örebro in 2000, develops SBS Manager, a platform that manages the complete case flow of grant-making organisations — from receiving applications and communicating with applicants to review, decision, budgeting and disbursement.

The societal case is concrete: applications become easier and more accessible for applicants, handling processes are drastically shortened, more grants are paid out and fraudulent behaviour is reduced. Adolf Lindgrens Stiftelse, one of digiPlant's customers, quadrupled its number of applications after moving to SBS Manager.

digiPlant is led by CEO Alexander Törnqvist and has held a AAA credit rating from Dun & Bradstreet for ten consecutive years.

digiPlant is PubliX Group's second partnership, following the acquisition of Tidvis earlier the same month, and continues under its own brand with its own team.
